info.name: Grow Logs API
info.description: API collection for the Grow Logs SaaS backend. All requests use the {{BASE_URL}} variable. The login request auto-sets {{ACCESS_TOKEN}} via a post-response script.

item.name: Login — unknown email gives same error as wrong password (401)

exec: pm.test('same generic message as wrong password — no user enumeration', () => {

item.name: Verify Email — happy path (200)
item.description: Paste the token printed to the dev server console after registering. In dev mode the server logs: [DEV] Verify: http://localhost:3001/verify-email?token=<TOKEN>. Copy the token value and set it as {{VERIFICATION_TOKEN}} in your environment.

item.name: Verify Email — idempotent, second call succeeds (200)
item.description: Calling verify-email twice with the same valid token must return 200 both times. Email clients pre-fetch links, so the second call must not error.

exec: pm.test('status is 200 on second call', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('message does not distinguish invalid from expired', () => {

item.name: Verify Email — validation failure, missing token (400)
Resend Verification — unknown email returns same 200 (no enumeration)
item.description: The endpoint must return 200 with the same message even for email addresses that have no account. This prevents an attacker from discovering which emails are registered.

exec: pm.test('status is 200 even for unknown email', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('same message as registered email (no enumeration)', () => {

item.description: Requires a valid ACCESS_TOKEN set by the Login request. Run Login first.

item.name: Change Password — same new password as current (400)
item.description: The Zod schema refine rejects a new password that matches the current password.

item.name: Change Password — validation failure, weak new password (400)
Update email — happy path (200)
item.description: Run Login first to get ACCESS_TOKEN. Set USER_NEW_EMAIL in the environment to a different email address.

item.name: Update email — duplicate email (409)
item.description: Try to claim an email address that belongs to another registered account.

item.description: User has fewer than 3 categories — onboarding should be blocked.
